purpose: Role-readable downstream/control state synchronized to O_CHAT control9 and DESIRED control25 for 19-role scheduled-Chat contribution parity with verified minimal irreducible handoffs.

non_regression.rule: Preserve every control31 authority-bootstrap, CLEAN-independence, continuation/recovery, exact identity/scope, CAS/readback, wave/feed, scheduler, useful-output and protected-primary boundary. Preserve each role's prior substantive/base continuation as fallback metadata. This revision changes only Phase-1 handoff/route acceptance and corresponding role methods.

policy.authority_bootstrap: inherit control31 SHA-only H1/exact-H1/H2 freeze, exact-blob fallback, ABA guard, receipt binding and diagnostic-only mismatch behavior unchanged
policy.clean_independence: Consume only permitted CLEAN outputs; never expose O, other-worker or downstream semantics to CLEAN explorers and never write explorer state/feedback.
policy.primary_o_boundary: No downstream role may acquire or alter primary O lease/fence/frozen request/protected execution state, direct-merge main or become a duplicate primary writer. A verified irreducible primary-writer effect is handed off minimally; downstream never executes it.
policy.identity_and_scope: Use exact source-qualified identity and tested scope; no fuzzy joins; omitted evidence is not assessed.
policy.wave_and_feed_integrity: Integrator remains sole ACTIVE_WAVE/index/feed coordinator. Preserve valid incomplete waves; require exact source pre/postflight, bootstrap_valid, current-blob CAS, full readback, lossless history and immutable own receipt.
policy.anti_stop: One result, checkpoint, no-change or blocker is never global completion. Completed/blocked/duplicate/low-value leaves are reassigned inside Phase 1.

scheduler_boundary.workers: Recurring enabled state is preserved across invocation boundaries, no-result runs, missing surfaces and blockers.
scheduler_boundary.optimizer: May re-enable only an intended enabled_desired role after cause repair and readback; never disables, pauses or deletes managed roles.

irreducible_handoff.execute_first: Complete every safely Chat-capable step with actually exposed tools before handoff classification.
irreducible_handoff.direct_and_existing_solution_first: Audit existing solutions and attempt a direct Chat route before declaring a remainder irreducible.
irreducible_handoff.verified_irreducible: A remaining action may satisfy a row only if evidence shows it requires protected-primary lease/fence/frozen-request/protected-state/merge authority or another genuinely Work-exclusive capability not exposed in scheduled Chat; the payload is minimal and duplicate-guarded.
irreducible_handoff.invalid: Unsupported, convenience, generic 'needs Work', quota-only, or otherwise reducible handoffs keep the row/leaf/ancestors unresolved.
irreducible_handoff.manual_user: Manual user execution is not a substitute. Genuine user-only authorization/input remains a user blocker.
irreducible_handoff.resource: Use only capabilities actually available now. Cost/quota/resilience are optimization and availability attributes, not independent closure gates unless unavailable/unauthorized.

phase1.root_problem: Make the full scheduled-Chat pool execute all safely Chat-capable work and hand off only unique minimal actions independently verified as irreducibly Work-exclusive or protected-primary-writer-only.
phase1.no_restore: Complete/block/low-value means checkpoint and reassign within Phase 1.

phase1_assignment.directive: Verify proposed Chat contribution routes against primary/current capability evidence. For each remainder, verify whether the effect is actually unavailable to scheduled Chat and truly protected-primary/Work-exclusive; reject unsupported or reducible handoffs; preserve exact scope.

A remaining action passes only after independent evidence of unique minimal irreducible Work-exclusive/protected-primary-writer status; unsupported/reducible handoffs fail closed.

work_delegation_gate.reason: The 19 intended roles plus protected O monitor fill the active-task cap; do not displace an intended role.
work_delegation_gate.policy: Standby only; do not displace an intended role. Preserve base queue/results and never target protected primary O.

quality_not_independent_closure_gates: zero-quota replay when not needed by the selected route
aggregate_acceptance.closure: Integrator and optimizer independently rederive every hard gate; evidence comparator independently verifies handoff reducibility/irreducibility, duplication, conflict, authority and usefulness. A verified minimal irreducible Work-exclusive/protected-primary-writer handoff may satisfy its row; unsupported/reducible handoffs do not.

migration.reason: Control31 propagated control8's blanket zero-residual-execution rule, contradicting the current user criterion that permits only precise irreducible Work-exclusive or primary-writer handoffs. Control32 restores that distinction while preserving all primary safety and baseline contracts.
migration.stale_prior_acceptance: Control31/root24 evidence remains historical. Any positive/negative oracle whose expected result depended on 'any residual Work/protected/user step must fail' is stale for current acceptance until reclassified under control32.
migration.rollback_condition: Only independently proven authority, identity, wave/feed, CLEAN-isolation, protected-primary safety, evidence-integrity or baseline-regression failure. Never rollback merely to restore blanket zero-residual-execution acceptance.
